headline: Sharda Saraogi files SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure under Takeover Code
sum: Sharda Saraogi has filed a substantial acquisition disclosure (Regulation 31(4)) with NSE in respect of Team India Guaranty Limited, indicating a significant change in shareholding or control triggering mandatory public disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Regulations.
detail: Sharda Saraogi has submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to the NSE. This regulation mandates that any person or group acquiring shares or voting rights such that their aggregate holding reaches or crosses a 5% threshold, or any subsequent acquisition of 2% (once at 5%+), must disclose within two trading days. The filing does not specify the acquisition quantum, timing, or price; however, the disclosure itself signals a controlled transaction subject to SEBI oversight. Team India Guaranty Limited is a financial services entity; the disclosure appears to pertain to either a primary acquisition by Saraogi or a change in control under the Takeover Code.
